definition: Mindpixel was a web-based collaborative artificial intelligence project which aimed to create a knowledgebase of millions of human validated true/false statements, or probabilistic propositions.
story: Imagine an art restorer who can spot a single cracked tile in a vast mosaic. Think of it this way: Mindpixel was a web-based collaborative artificial intelligence project which aimed to create a knowledgebase of millions of human validated true/false statements, or probabilistic propositions. And here is the clever part: It ran from 2000 to 2005. The model looks the way you look at a crowd and finds the one face you know. And that is Mindpixel — giving a machine the gift of sight.
